verses.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
verses.pt: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, pela vontade de Deus, e o irmão Timóteo, para a igreja de Deus que está em Corinto, com todos os santos que estão em toda a Acaia.
verses.en_web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:
verses.en_bbe: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the purpose of God, and Timothy the brother, to the church of God which is in Corinth, with all the saints who are in all Achaia:

verses.en: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Graça e paz de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
verses.pt: Bendito seja o Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, o Pai das misericórdias, e o Deus de toda consolação,
verses.en_web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;
verses.en_bbe: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort;

verses.en: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
verses.pt: Que nos consola em toda aflição nossa, para que também possamos consolar aos que estiverem em alguma aflição, com a consolação com que nós mesmos por Deus somos consolados.
verses.en_web: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
verses.en_bbe: Who gives us comfort in all our troubles, so that we may be able to give comfort to others who are in trouble, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

verses.en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
verses.pt: Porque assim como os sofrimentos de Cristo são abundantes em nós, assim também por Cristo é abundante nossa consolação.
verses.en_web: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For as we undergo more of the pain which Christ underwent, so through Christ does our comfort become greater.

verses.en: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
verses.pt: Porém se nós somos afligidos, é para vossa consolação e salvação, que opera enquanto se suporta os mesmos sofrimentos que nós também sofremos; se estamos consolados, também é para vossa consolação e salvação
verses.en_web: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.
verses.en_bbe: But if we are troubled, it is for your comfort and salvation; or if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which takes effect through your quiet undergoing of the same troubles which we undergo:

verses.en: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
verses.pt: E nossa esperança por vós é firme, sabendo que, como sois participantes dos sofrimentos, assim também sois da consolação.
verses.en_web: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so also are you of the comfort.
verses.en_bbe: And our hope for you is certain; in the knowledge that as you take part in the troubles, so you will take part in the comfort.

verses.en: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
verses.pt: Porque, irmãos, não queremos que ignoreis nossa aflição que nos sobreveio na Ásia, em que fomos excessivamente oprimidos, mais do que podíamos suportar, de tal modo que já tínhamos perdido a esperança de sobrevivermos.
verses.en_web: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia, that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
verses.en_bbe: For it is our desire that you may not be without knowledge of our trouble which came on us in Asia, that the weight of it was very great, more than our power, so that it seemed that we had no hope even of life:

verses.en: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
verses.pt: Por isso já tínhamos em nós mesmos a sentença de morte, para que não confiássemos em nós mesmos, mas sim em Deus, que ressuscita aos mortos;
verses.en_web: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
verses.en_bbe: Yes, we ourselves have had the answer of death in ourselves, so that our hope might not be in ourselves, but in God who is able to give life to the dead:

verses.en: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
verses.pt: O qual nos livrou de tamanha morte, e ainda nos livra; nele esperamos que também ainda nos livrará;
verses.en_web: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us;
verses.en_bbe: Who gave us salvation from so great a death: on whom we have put our hope that he will still go on to give us salvation;

verses.en: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
verses.pt: Junto do vosso auxílio com oração por nós, a fim de que, pelo favor concedido a nós por causa de muitas pessoas, por muitos sejam dadas graças a Deus por nós.
verses.en_web: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
verses.en_bbe: You at the same time helping together by your prayer for us; so that for what has been given to us through a number of persons, praise may go up to God for us from all of them.

verses.en: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
verses.pt: Porque nosso orgulho é este: o testemunho de nossa consciência, que com simplicidade e sinceridade de Deus, não com sabedoria carnal, mas com a graça de Deus, nós nos comportamos no mundo, e especialmente convosco.
verses.en_web: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.
verses.en_bbe: For our glory is in this, in the knowledge which we have that our way of life in the world, and most of all in relation to you, has been holy and true in the eyes of God; not in the wisdom of the flesh, but in the grace of God.

verses.en: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
verses.pt: Porque nenhuma outra coisa vos escrevemos, a não ser as que já sabeis, ou também entendeis; e espero que as entendereis por completo.
verses.en_web: For we write no other things to you, than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end;
verses.en_bbe: For in our letters we say no other things to you, but those which you are reading, and to which you give agreement, and, it is my hope, will go on doing so to the end:

verses.en: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.pt: Assim como também já em parte tendes nos entendido, que somos vosso orgulho, como também vós sois o nosso orgulho no dia do Senhor Jesus.
verses.en_web: as also you acknowledged us in part, that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: Even as you have been ready, in part, to say that we are your glory, in the same way that you are ours, in the day of the Lord Jesus.

verses.en: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
verses.pt: E com esta confiança eu quis primeiro vir até vós, para que tivésseis uma segunda graça;
verses.en_web: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit;
verses.en_bbe: And being certain of this, it was my purpose to come to you before, so that you might have a second grace;

verses.en: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
verses.pt: E por vós passar para a Macedônia; e da Macedônia vir outra vez até vós; e depois ser enviado por vós até a Judeia.
verses.en_web: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.
verses.en_bbe: And by way of Corinth to go into Macedonia, and from there to come back again to you, so that you might send me on my way to Judaea.

verses.en: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
verses.pt: Quando eu planejei isso, por acaso fiz de forma irresponsável? Ou o que eu planejo, planejo segundo a carne, para que eu diga sim e não ao mesmo tempo?
verses.en_web: When I therefore was thus determined, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”
verses.en_bbe: If then I had such a purpose, did I seem to be changing suddenly? or am I guided in my purposes by the flesh, saying, Yes, today, and, No, tomorrow?

verses.en: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
verses.pt: Porém assim como Deus é fiel, nossa palavra para vós não foi sim e não ao mesmo tempo.
verses.en_web: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”
verses.en_bbe: As God is true, our word to you is not Yes and No.

verses.en: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
verses.pt: Porque o Filho de Deus, Jesus Cristo, o que por nós foi pregado entre vós, isto é, por mim, e Silvano, e Timóteo, não foi sim e não, mas nele foi o “sim”.
verses.en_web: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, by me, Silvanus, and Timothy, was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”
verses.en_bbe: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, whom we were preaching among you, even I and Silvanus and Timothy, was not Yes and No, but in him is Yes.

verses.en: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
verses.pt: Porque todas as promessas nele são “sim”, e nele se diga Amém, para glória de Deus por meio de nós.
verses.en_web: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.
verses.en_bbe: For he is the Yes to all the undertakings of God: and by him all the words of God are made certain and put into effect, to the glory of God through us.

verses.en: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
verses.pt: Mas o que nos confirma convosco, e o que nos ungiu, é Deus.
verses.en_web: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ, and anointed us, is God;
verses.en_bbe: Now he who makes our faith strong together with you, in Christ, and has given us of his grace, is God;

verses.en: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
verses.pt: O qual também nos selou, e nos deu o penhor do Espírito em nosso corações.
verses.en_web: who also sealed us, and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
verses.en_bbe: And it is he who has put his stamp on us, even the Spirit, as the sign in our hearts of the coming glory.

verses.en: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
verses.pt: Porém invoco a Deus por testemunha sobre minha alma, que para vos poupar, até agora não vim a Corinto.
verses.en_web: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that I didn’t come to Corinth to spare you.
verses.en_bbe: But God is my witness that it was in pity for you that I did not come to Corinth at that time.

verses.en: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
verses.pt: Não que sejamos senhores de vossa fé; porém somos cooperadores de vossa alegria. Porque pela fé estais firmes.
verses.en_web: Not that we control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
verses.en_bbe: Not that we have authority over your faith, but we are helpers of your joy: for it is faith which is your support.
